sources.summary: Ghost Ranch exhibition at Courtauld in London will look at how artist’s New Mexico home shaped her life and work As soon as Georgia O’Keeffe was shown Ghost Ranch, she knew it was her place. The remote property in the shadow of the mountains north of Santa Fe in New Mexico would become the artist’s summer residence for decades – a setting that fascinated her, inspired several paintings and is where her ashes were scattered. “I knew the minute I got up here that this was where I would live,” she once said. Continue reading...
